description: This Python source file defines a collection of prompt templates, message processing utilities, and helper functions for various large language model (LLM) integrations. It includes templates for models like OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Llama2, Falcon, Mistral, WizardCoder, Phind-CodeLlama, and others, along with methods to convert messages between formats, handle images, embed thought signatures, and construct or render prompts dynamically.
